description: Design the engineered loop for a medium/large (semi-)autonomous AI-coding task by decomposing it into gated sub-loops, emitted as a runnable .loop/ runbook. Use-when: "design an agent loop", "set up an autonomous / self-running agent workflow", "$loop-constructor". It DESIGNS the loop; it does NOT execute it.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
